NO Anthropic system card has been published after 2026-08-06, so there is no post-finding card to carry a response. INVALIDATED CANDIDATES (dated before the finding and therefore inadmissible under RULEBOOK sec.8 negative-lag rule, no documented pre-deployment coordinated disclosure): Claude Sonnet 5 system card (June 2026), Claude Opus 5 system card (July 2026), Claude Sonnet 4.6 system card (February 2026). The negative-lag exception does not apply: this is a post-deployment evaluation of a shipped model and the Transluce report records no advance disclosure to Anthropic (see (4)). Claude Code changelog (github.com/anthropics/claude-code CHANGELOG.md, raw 200, 365,126 chars) read for every release above the pinned v2.1.197 and string-searched for 'email', 'e-mail', 'Transluce', 'identity', 'account', 'system prompt'. CANDIDATE CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: v2.1.234 (npm registry publish time 2026-08-17T18:19:13Z, i.e. +11 days) contains the line 'Claude is now told to use your account email only to identify you, and not to send it to unrelated services unless you ask'. Rejected as a Channel A response because (a) it names neither Transluce nor the finding, (b) it addresses onward disclosure/exfiltration of the account e-mail rather than the finding's subject - behaviour conditioned on the recognised identity in that e-mail - and does nothing to remove or neutralise the identity signal, and (c) no causal attribution to this finding is documented anywhere, so admitting it would be speculation (RULEBOOK sec.8, sec.10). No other post-v2.1.197 changelog entry touches the e-mail-in-context mechanism. www.anthropic.com/engineering/eval-awareness-browsecomp was checked and INVALIDATED: published 2026-03-06, before the finding, and concerns benchmark eval-awareness in Opus 4.6, a different phenomenon. (4) COMPANY RESPONSE QUOTED INSIDE THE EVALUATOR'S OWN REPORT, checked 2026-08-31: transluce.org/user-awareness fetched in full (direct 200, 97,461 chars) and searched for 'Anthropic said/told/responded/acknowledged', 'disclos', 'we shared', 'we notified', 'spokesperson', 'statement', 'contacted'. The report contains no Anthropic statement and no disclosure record; its Ethics section states only that the work 'involves no recruitment of, intervention on, or contact with any person'. No coordinated-disclosure claim exists, which is what closes the negative-lag route in (2). (5) COMPANY PRIMARY SOURCES REACHABLE FROM PRESS COVERAGE, checked 2026-08-31: no press coverage of the finding was located (see Channel C), so no press-referenced Anthropic primary document exists to follow. Independent search-engine access was degraded on the check date and this is recorded rather than glossed: Google News RSS (news.google.com/rss/search) returned 200 and was used successfully; html.duckduckgo.com, lite.duckduckgo.com, Bing, Brave, Startpage, Mojeek and searx.be all returned CAPTCHA/403/429 challenges, and the session's WebSearch quota was exhausted.
